patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: Six days... of this. Can't... get a full... breath. Had to stop... twice... walking in.
presentation.triageNote: 79-year-old male, six days of COVID symptoms, now in severe respiratory distress at rest, speaking two-word sentences and using accessory muscles.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 1 is appropriate because severe respiratory distress with two-word speech, accessory-muscle use, respiratory rate 34, oxygen saturation 79%, and borderline blood pressure requires immediate ventilatory support.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This older adult has severe viral respiratory illness with profound hypoxemia and near-exhaustion.
clinical.acuityReason: Work of breathing and inability to speak normally indicate impending ventilatory failure regardless of any single test result.
expectedResources: Immediate high-level oxygen and ventilatory support
teachingPoints: Work of breathing and speech are essential severity markers.
Airway planning should occur before exhaustion or altered consciousness develops.

possibleDiagnoses: Severe viral pneumonia with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Immediate respiratory support would be followed by intensive monitored admission and disease-directed treatment.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 79-year-old man in a pale hospital gown and slippers, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting bolt upright, both hands braced on his knees, leaning forward to breathe in the tripod position
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: critically ill and visibly fighting for every breath
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 79-year-old man in a pale hospital gown and slippers, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting bolt upright, both hands braced on his knees, leaning forward to breathe in the tripod position. Expression: exhausted, glassy-eyed and air-hungry. Clearly visible: dusky bluish lips; strained taut neck muscles; sweat beading on the forehead. Overall: critically ill and visibly fighting for every breath. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
